2026-07-21 13:10:41.837135 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837140 | controller |
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837145 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837150 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837153 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837157 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837160 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-21 13:10:41.837164 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
